thread:
anna: Quick all-hands follow-up — thanks for the great turnout. Recording, slides, and a short Q&A roundup below. TL;DR: roadmap signals for H2, hiring ramp for infra/serving, and a hybrid offsite in November. Please add any follow-ups in the doc.

eric: recording + slides: https://redwood.cloud/recordings/2456789012-allhands.mp4 and https://drive.redwood/company/allhands/2456789012-slides.pdf

june: summary bullets from the execs: 1) focus H2 on latency and cost optimizations, 2) Dedicated GA prep ramping, 3) customer audit readiness improvements.

meera: hiring note: infra & serving team hiring ramp approved — expect 6 IC roles and 2 staff hires over the next quarter. Recruiting to post job links tomorrow.

hr_bot: Offsite logistics: hybrid offsite Nov 10-12. All-hands day on Nov 11. Remote-friendly agenda and travel stipends details to be posted: https://hr.redwood/offsites/nov-2026

alex: question from Q&A: will we expand manager headcount with the hiring ramp? exec answer in slides: modest manager hires, focus on IC hiring first, then leads as needed.

maya: product ask: any change to the roadmap priorities for partner-facing features? execs said small shift — more polish on Dedicated and routing policies, some feature garage for next cycle.

ops_bot: Follow-ups doc created: https://docs.redwood/company/allhands/2456789012-followups. Owners assigned for hiring, offsite, and roadmap sync.

june: action items captured: 1) recruiting to publish job posts (owner @meera) by Tue; 2) ops to publish Dedicated GA checklist (owner @alex) by Fri; 3) people-ops to post offsite FAQ & travel stipends (owner @hr_bot) by Mon.

meera: will post job links tomorrow morning and tag hiring managers. Also setting up a small hiring Q&A drop-in next Thu.

anna: tiny ask: if you have burning product or partner asks, add them to the follow-ups doc. We'll prioritize into the roadmap grooming session next week.

alex: demo clip (slide 6) had a UI glitch on the model picker — filing a small ticket now. Not blocking but let's fix before partner preview.

ops_bot: Transcript: https://redwood.cloud/transcripts/2456789012.txt

june: marketing: Maya, will you draft a 3-bullet public summary for the blog (non-technical) so we can announce the offsite and hiring ramp? keep it high level.

maya: can do. draft bullets: 1) Redwood accelerating infrastructure hiring to support Dedicated GA and performance work; 2) Hybrid offsite Nov 10-12 — building cross-team alignment; 3) Continued investment in cost & latency improvements. Ill post a draft by EOD.

anna: thanks all. If you missed it, please watch the recording and add follow-ups to the doc. We'll post a short update in #product after the roadmap grooming is done.
